run_uvicorn_prod: run the uvicorn server in production mode on port 8080 with prod.env
run_uvicorn_dev: run the uvicorn server in development mode on port 8000 with dev.env
run_main_fire: run the main function via fire CLI with a setting argument like prod or dev
review_main_function: review the main function that configures and starts a uvicorn ASGI server
summarize_uvicorn_config: summarize the uvicorn configuration including host port env file reload and logging
